title: Master Mind Scholarships
provider: Government of Flanders (Flemish Ministry of Education and Training)
description: Scholarships to promote the inflow of international students to Flemish higher education, for outstanding students of any nationality admitted to a master's programme at a Flemish university or university college.
amount: EUR 10,000 per year towards living costs plus a reduced tuition fee

title: VLIR-UOS Scholarships
provider: VLIR-UOS (Flemish Interuniversity Council - University Cooperation for Development)
description: Scholarships for students from a defined list of developing countries to follow a master's programme or short training programme in Flanders, aimed at building capacity for sustainable development.
amount: Full tuition, monthly allowance, travel, insurance and settling-in allowance

title: ARES Scholarships
provider: Academie de recherche et d'enseignement superieur (ARES, Wallonia-Brussels Federation)
field: Development-related fields (public health, agriculture, environment, governance, engineering)
description: Scholarships from the French-speaking community of Belgium for professionals from partner developing countries to follow a specialised master's or training course in Wallonia or Brussels.
amount: Full tuition, monthly allowance, travel, insurance and installation costs

title: KU Leuven Global Minds / Science@Leuven Scholarships
field: Science, engineering, technology and selected other master's programmes
description: Institutional scholarships for outstanding international students admitted to an eligible master's programme at KU Leuven, ranging from partial to full support depending on the scheme and the applicant's background.
amount: Partial to full tuition plus, for some awards, a living allowance

title: Ghent University Special Research Fund (BOF) Doctoral Scholarships
description: Doctoral scholarships funded by the university's Special Research Fund, including dedicated calls for candidates from developing countries, providing a full stipend and research support.
amount: Full doctoral scholarship (tax-exempt grant) plus social security cover and a bench fee
